name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Groups related buttons into one control, or joins a main action with its options as a split button.

name: button
title: Button
description: Starts an action on this page or submits a form.

name: close-button
title: Close button
description: The icon-only button that closes a dialog, sheet, banner or panel, named "Close" in the current language.

name: fab
title: Floating action button
description: Keeps one task reachable over scrolling content, as a button or a link, collapsing to its icon on phones.

name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Pick files with a button or by dropping them, validate size and type, and show each file with its progress or error.

name: link-button
title: Link button
description: A link that looks like a button: a call to action that goes to another page.

name: link
title: Link
description: Text that goes to another page, inline in running text or as a standalone subtle link.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme toggle
description: Lets people choose system, light or dark theme, stored per device and applied before first paint.

name: toggle-button
title: Toggle button
description: A button that stays pressed or not, alone or in a group where one or several options are on.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or a company shown by photo, initials or icon, alone or in a stacked group.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A count or an unread dot next to a label or on an icon.

name: card
title: Card
description: A surface that groups related content about one object, optionally a link or a button as a whole.

name: heading
title: Heading
description: A page or section title on the type scale, with its HTML level separate from its size.

name: icon
title: Icon
description: Draws any Lucide icon by name, sized and colored with theme tokens.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as a keycap in help text, menus and tooltips.

name: lozenge
title: Lozenge
description: A short status word in a colored pill, one meaning per tone.

name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A region that scrolls inside a height limit with thin themed scrollbars, keyboard reachable.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: A thin line between groups that spacing alone does not separate, optionally with a short label.

name: text
title: Text
description: Body copy, captions and inline text on the type scale, plus Prose for long rich text.

name: banner
title: Banner
description: A message about the page or the whole app, inline or floating, in an information, warning, danger or success tone.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Explains why a view has no content or failed to load, and offers the action that changes that.

name: meter
title: Meter
description: A segmented gauge for a quantity within a known range, with warning and danger thresholds.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: Shows how far a task has got, as a bar or a circle, determinate or indeterminate.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shapes in the layout of content that is still loading.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A small indeterminate loading indicator.

name: status-dot
title: Status dot
description: A small colored dot with a word for a live system state: online, syncing, offline.

name: field
title: Field
description: A label, hint and error row around any control, wired for screen readers; plus the label, description and error parts.

name: form
title: Form
description: A form with consistent rhythm, sections with legends, side-by-side rows and a footer for its actions.

name: input-group
title: Input group
description: Joins an input with addons (text, icons) and actions (buttons) into one bordered control.

name: input-otp
title: One-time code
description: Boxes for a one-time verification code, with paste, autofill and a resend cooldown.

name: number-field
title: Number field
description: A locale-aware number input with steppers, ranges, units and currency.

name: password-field
title: Password field
description: A password input with a show/hide toggle and an optional strength meter.

name: search-field
title: Search field
description: A search input with a clear button and Escape to clear.

name: text-area
title: Text area
description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content, with an optional character count.

name: text-field
title: Text field
description: A single-line text input with label, description, error, addons and actions.

name: box
title: Box
description: A container with token-only padding, background, radius, border and shadow.

name: grid
title: Grid
description: Equal columns, fixed or auto-fit to a minimum width, with a token gap.

name: inline
title: Inline
description: Lays children out side by side on the inline axis, wrapping by default.

name: pressable
title: Pressable
description: A Box that is a button or a link as a whole, for custom tiles and rows.

name: section
title: Section
description: Full-width page bands with a centered container and a head of overline, title and lead.

name: stack
title: Stack
description: Stacks children vertically with a token gap.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
description: Asks people to confirm or cancel one consequential action, optionally by typing a confirmation.

name: command-palette
title: Command palette
description: A ⌘K search over actions and records, with recent items, groups and server results.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window for a focused task, with a title, body and footer actions, in small to full-screen sizes.

name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the side, or a bottom sheet on phones, for detail and edit views beside the page.

name: menu
title: Menu
description: A list of actions under a button, with sections, icons, shortcuts and disabled items that say why.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Non-modal content anchored to a trigger: extra detail, a small form, a picker.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Brief messages about what just happened, with one optional action; call toast() anywhere under the provider.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short hint for a control on hover and keyboard focus, and on tap for touch users when needed.

name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: Free text with suggestions loaded as people type, grouped and with detail lines.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A box to turn one option on or off, or a group of boxes for several options.

name: combobox
title: Combo box
description: Type to filter a long list and pick one or several items, with load-more and app-side results.

name: multi-select
title: Multi-select
description: Pick several options from a dropdown; the choices show as removable tags, with an optional select-all.

name: radio-card
title: Radio card
description: Radio options as cards with a title, description and an optional recommended mark: plans, tiers, methods.

name: radio
title: Radio group
description: One choice from a few options that all stay visible.

name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one option from a short list in a dropdown, with groups, descriptions and icons.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Picks a value or a range by dragging along a track, with locale-formatted output.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: Turns a setting on or off immediately.

name: tag-group
title: Tag group
description: A group of tags that can be removed or selected: features, filters, keywords.
